mapper.select: select rjr.RULE_TYPE1 as ruleType1, rjr.RULE_TYPE2 as ruleType2, rjr.RULE_TYPE3 as ruleType3, rjr.RULE_TYPE4 as ruleType4 from REP_JOB_RANGE rjr where rjr.JOB_ID=#{jobId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT rr.ID as id,rr.RULE_NAME as text,rr.REP_NAME as col FROM REP_RULE rr left join REP_INFO ri on ri.REP_ID=rr.REP_ID

select rj.JOB_ID jobId, rj.JOB_NAME jobName, rj.LOOP_DATE_TYPE loopDateType, rj.LOOP_DATE_VALUE loopDateValue, rj.ISPRODRELATED isProdRelated, rj.LOOP_DATE_DETAIL loopDateDetail, rj.START_DATE startDate, rj.END_DATE endDate, rj.RULE_ID ruleId, rj.CREATE_USER createUser, rj.CREATE_DEPT createDept, rj.CREATE_TIME createTime, rj.UPDATE_USER updateUser, rj.UPDATE_TIME updateTime,ri.REPORT_NAME repName from REP_JOB rj left join REP_RULE rr on rj.RULE_ID=rr.ID left join REP_INFO ri on rr.REP_ID = ri.REP_ID where rj.JOB_ID=#{jobId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
